title: Decision rights and trust rules (section 10)
description: Who can approve what, and what is never delegated to an agent.

id.description: Stable identifier; never reused or renumbered.

stages.description: The journey stages whose decision this rule governs.

approver.description: The role that may approve it.

delegable_to_agent.description: Whether an agent may make this decision unaided.

never_delegated.description: True when a person must decide, always, whatever the confidence.

evidence_required.description: What the approver must be shown before deciding.

escalation.description: What happens when the approver is unavailable or disagrees.

acceptance.description: Given/When/Then statements that prove the rule holds.
